## DG3 round 6 QA verdict: **PASS**, no new findings

I reviewed candidate `sha256:7049d793…1c3f96` (757 files, source `c40232b`). The ID recomputed the same at the start and end of the run, in the repo and in two disposable clones, which I have since deleted. HEAD moved from `36411df` to `00cb9fa` during the run, but only files under `docs/delivery/` changed. I did not read any other reviewer's round-6 record.

**The round-6 repair (T-DG3-KBE-H), tested from the acceptance side:**
- **Engine code:** none of the formula engine's source changed.
- **New lint rules:** I added 14 forbidden patterns of my own (generators, `yield`, `then`/`catch`/`finally` as names, `fromAsync`, `asyncIterator`) to both `parse.ts` and `value.ts`. Lint flags all 14, and the source scan fails on them.
- **Earlier rules:** all 17 round-5 patterns are still refused. The two allowed shapes are not flagged.
- **Run-time guard:** an injected code generation in each of the 4 catch sites still fails the no-codegen test run, with the same failure counts as round 5 (73, 24, 4 and 103).
- **Behaviour:** `formatDecimal` still shows Unknown for invalid values, and the formula API still returns 422 for invalid formulas. The formula examples are exact (100000 SAR, 0.02×100000×50, 151852.11).
- **`pnpm test`:** both Vitest runs execute: 1651 tests, then 256 passed and 2 skipped.

**Full regression:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks (typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI with 270 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast) | All exit 0 |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | Green (one rerun, see below) |
| Integration, twice on fresh PostgreSQL | 793/793 both times; migrations 0001–0027; all 270 operations live; every pending list empty |
| e2e, both locale settings, chromium-en and chromium-ar | 216 passed and 2 failed each time (explained below); per-spec counts identical to round 5 |
| Accessibility (axe) | 0 violations of any impact |
| Arabic RTL / English LTR, auditor read-only | All checks pass |
| All 32 DG3 requirements | Each traces to passing checks in both languages and both settings |
| F-DG3-180 layout probe | Still holds: 7 of 7 badges inside their cards |
| Validators (`--register DG3`, `--pipeline`, `--historical` DG2 and DG1) | PASS at start and end |

**Failures in the logs, all disclosed in the record:**
1. **One unit-test failure on Node 24 (locale unset).** A DG2 sign-out test timed out while the shared 4-CPU host was under heavy load. No data leaked, and the test file is unchanged since DG2. The full rerun passed, and the file alone passed 8 of 8 times. This is the same timing flake I reported in round 3.
2. **F180b layout probe fails by design, in all 4 runs.** 7 of 77 rows fail, all at 390 px width with 200% text. The existing gate grid makes the page wider than the screen, but each badge stays inside its card with no clipping or overlap. This is identical to rounds 3–5 and is an observation, not a finding.
3. **My mutation probes exit non-zero by design.** One placement slip in my own probe was corrected and is disclosed.

**Observation, not a finding:** when G4 is refused, the "Finance validation" message repeats once per unvalidated item. It is unchanged since round 5, and the acceptance text still holds.

**Environmental residuals:** the live registry (D-057), live CI (D-058) and Keycloak (D-049) are unavailable here. As the assignment instructs, I recorded each as PASS on the offline/configuration surface and noted the residual.

**Findings:** none, so no findings sidecar was written.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG3/round-6/qa-verifier.json (validated against the schema)
- reviews/DG3/round-6/qa-verifier.md
- test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-6/ (start with RUN-NOTES.md)
- test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-6/e2e/dg3-qa-r6.spec.ts
